title: Epithelial Rests of Malassez Form a Wnt-Dependent Mechanoresponsive Network
html:
Journal of Dental Research, Ahead of Print.
Epithelial rests of Malassez (ERMs) constitute a 3-dimensional epithelial meshwork extending from the tooth apex to the junctional epithelium (JE). This position, coupled with observations from a variety of injury models, suggests that ERMs may be ...
